<?php
// A plugin upload handler: capability and nonce checked, name sanitized.
if ( current_user_can( "manage_options" ) && check_admin_referer( "import" ) ) {
    $target = $dir . "/" . basename( $_FILES["import"]["name"] );
    move_uploaded_file( $_FILES["import"]["tmp_name"], $target );
}
